name: D.C. II ~Da Capo II~ Dearest Marriage
original_name: D.C.II Dearest Marriage ～ダ・カーポII～ ディアレストマリッジ
source:
A story of Otome and Yoshiyuki's married life. Features 3 chapters continuing Otome's Route.

“Graduation days” takes place during Yoshiyuki’s final year at Kazami Academy and shows the last fun-filled days for their close circle of friends, culminating with the graduation party. “Married life” details Yoshiyuki and Otome’s daily lovey-dovey lives after his proposal on his graduation day. 

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/04/01/april-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
講述音姬與義之的婚後生活，包含延續音姬路線的3個章節。

「畢業時光」發生在義之就讀風見學園的最後一年，描寫好友們最後那段充滿歡樂的日子，並以畢業派對收尾。「婚後生活」則講述義之在畢業當天求婚後，與音姬每天如膠似漆的生活。

［改編自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/04/01/april-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]］
